title: Encanto. The magic house.
lines: High in the green mountains of Colombia, where butterflies fly and flowers bloom in every colour, stands a very special house.
And Casita is a magic house!
The floor tiles dance up and down.
The doors open and close by themselves.
The windows flap like little wings.
And when you want to go up the stairs, the stairs turn into a slide.
Casita is like a big, friendly pet.
The Madrigal family lives in Casita.
There are grandpas and grandmas, aunts and uncles and lots and lots of children.
The boss is Abuela, the grandma.
Long ago Abuela was given a magic candle.
And thanks to that candle every child in the family gets a magic gift when they turn five.
Every child has their own door.
And when you get your gift, your door starts to glow.
She can even lift donkeys, and they bray: Hee-haw!
She just carries them on her shoulders.
Isabela is very pretty and very neat.
And Isabela can make flowers grow!
Roses, lilies and flowers in every colour.
When she laughs, a rain of little pink flowers falls.
When she's happy, the sun shines.
But when she's sad, it rains above her head.
And when she's angry, there's thunder.
He has a friend, a jaguar.
There's cousin Camilo, who can turn into anyone.
She has curly black hair and she wears big, round, green glasses.
When she turned five, she went to her door.
That makes Mirabel a little sad.
Everyone in the family has something magic, except her.
She dances, she sings, and she makes everyone laugh.
One evening there's a big party, because Antonio is getting his gift.
But then Mirabel sees something strange.
But Mirabel goes to find out.
She finds her uncle Bruno, who had been hiding in the walls with his rat friends.
And Mirabel is in that vision.
Mirabel goes to talk to her sisters.
Luisa says she's tired, that she always has to be strong.
Isabela says she doesn't really want to be perfect all the time.
She wants to grow something wild for once.
And suddenly Isabela grows a big cactus!
And climbing plants and purple flowers.
But Abuela is angry with Mirabel.
Mirabel runs away, to the river.
How she had to flee long ago.
And Abuela says: I'm sorry, Mirabel.
You are the miracle of our family.
Mirabel brings the whole family together again.
Everyone helps to build a new house.
Luisa lifts, Isabela makes flowers grow, and the whole village helps.
Mirabel makes a new doorknob for the house.
She puts it in the door.
Mirabel, with her big green glasses, has saved the family's magic.
